name: Low-Sun Golden Hour Rim
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Specify `5-degree low-angle golden hour sun`, long crisp shadows, glowing translucent hair/ridge rim halos, warm atmospheric dust haze, and cool sky fill inside deep shadows.

name: Cobalt Blue Hour + Warm Practicals
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Contrast cool deep-indigo ambient twilight sky (`7000K`) with isolated warm tungsten window/lantern practicals (`2700K`) for effortless cinematic depth.

name: Rembrandt 45° Studio Key
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Place key light 45° off-axis and slightly above eyeline so a small crisp triangle of light illuminates the shadow-side cheek while preserving sculptural falloff.

name: Chiaroscuro & Noir Shadow Slicing
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Push high key-to-fill contrast (`8:1`), hard-edged venetian blind/doorway shadow cuts, glowing cigarette/steam wisps catching narrow beams, and deep crushed blacks.

name: Dual Split Neon Rim
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Separate foreground subject cleanly using opposing cool electric cyan rim from left and warm magenta/amber storefront glow from right over dark wet environment.

name: Overcast Diffused Sky Softbox
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Use vast overcast cloud cover as a natural overhead softbox: smooth shadow transitions, rich saturated foliage/garment pigments, and crisp specular catches off damp surfaces.

name: Volumetric Light Shafts
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Drive visible crepuscular rays (`volumetric sunlight shafts piercing pine canopy / high arched windows`) illuminated by airborne dust, incense smoke, or valley mist.

name: Intimate 1900K Candlelight Falloff
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Anchor practical illumination at `1900K` candle/lantern warmth with rapid inverse-square falloff fading into deep indigo room corners.

name: Sodium-Vapor Night Street Ambience
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Mix harsh amber sodium-vapor pools (`2200K`) with cool moonless shadow voids, reflective asphalt sheen, and sharp shadow casting under shoes and vehicles.

name: Crisp Rim-Lit Silhouette
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Place strong directional light directly behind subject against haze/bright portal so core silhouette remains cleanly readable while blazing bright gold/white rims trace coat edges and hair.

name: Specular Water Bounce Fill
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Include subtle undulating upward bounce patterns reflected from sunlit water across underside arches, boat hulls, and subject jawline.

name: Cool Fluorescent Tubes & Subway
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Use overhead industrial `4500K` slightly green-shifted fluorescent tube rows receding down tiled corridors with crisp floor glare.

name: Clamshell Softwrap Glamour
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Employ top octabox key paired with soft silver bottom fill reflector eliminating harsh under-eye shadows while keeping twin clean catchlights.

name: 90° Hard Side Split Key
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Cut illumination sharply across the center bridge of the face (`90-degree hard side key`), leaving one hemisphere intensely textured with sweat/scars and the other sunken into velvet dark.

name: Dynamic Firelight & Rising Sparks
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Ground low upward orange flame key across faces and armor/wool folds while tiny glowing embers drift into cool night sky behind.

name: Cold Moonlight & Shadow Retention
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Keep night sky deep Prussian blue (`not crushed solid black`), tracing silver specular highlights along water ripples, leaves, and snowy ridges.

name: Chromatic Prism & Stained Glass
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Project crisp sapphire, ruby, and gold geometric light shards across stone pillars and clothing folds while surrounding vault shadows stay dusty and cool.

name: Organic Bioluminescent Accent
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Anchor subtle localized teal/violet biological light emitters illuminating only immediate mist and bark within short radius against dark ambient canopy.

name: Rose-Gold Alpine Ridge Strike
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Contrast fiery rose-orange sun striking upper snow ridges against deep icy-cyan shaded mountain faces and misty valley floor.

name: Layered Aerial Mist Separation
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Separate foreground (`high-contrast dark silhouettes`), midground (`translucent suspended haze`), and distant horizon (`pale luminous fade`) cleanly across 3+ tonal depth planes.

name: Stormfront Cloud-Break Spotlight
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Drive a sharp opening through bruised slate thunderheads casting one radiant sunlit patch over hillside rock or lighthouse while surrounding sea stays moody.

name: Flagged Overhead Gallery Fresnel
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Tightly shape beam spill via overhead soft-edge fresnel spot fading steeply into dark charcoal hall periphery.

name: Balanced Cinema Teal-Amber Grade
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Keep skin highlights natural warm peach/amber while deep shadows, metal, and night foliage settle cleanly toward subtle slate-teal without radioactive skin clipping.

name: Airy High-Key Daylight Wrap
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Flood interior with soft reflected north skylight across pale plaster and sheer linen curtains while retaining crisp black pupil and seam definition.
